title: Version Update - Adding BTM to DBS
author: Opentrons
materials: Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish Slot
Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: Ensure the JSON labware definition file includes the glass trough (Electron Microscopy Sciences), Omegaquant 96‑Well Plate, Blood Tube Rack, and 200 µL Tip Rack.

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package containing the custom labware definitions for the reservoir and plate.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later), upload the custom labware definition JSON file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload this updated protocol (API Version 2) into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the map:

substeps.instruction: Place the Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish in Slot 1.
Place the Corning 96‑Well Plate 360 µL Flat in Slot 2.
Place the Opentrons 96 Tip Rack 300 µL in Slot 4.
Mount the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette on the Left mount.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Using the customizations field, specify the number of samples for the run and the column from which tip pickup should start.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the labware, tip rack, and the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette (refer to Opentrons calibration support articles).

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the protocol.
